description: IPA-transliterated perception snippets used for zero-shot CE evaluation in the SCiL 2026 v2 paper. Source files renamed from transliteration_{lang}_ipa_{timestamp}.txt to perception_{lang}.txt to match scripts.zero_shot_eval default template.

perception_fi.txt.produced_by: Austin Wagner (2026-06-30), IPA rendered via turkic_translit.core.to_ipa with fi_ipa.rules

notes: perception_fi.txt was added 2026-06-30 to enable Turkic-listener-scoring-Finnish-target excess-CE runs. The 20 parallel passages (4 texts x 5 sub-passages, matching the six Turkic sets) were translated into Finnish at B2 register from the source content shared across the Turkic set, saved as perception_fi_source.txt, and transliterated via turkic_translit.core.to_ipa. Native-Finnish spot-check on the source orthography is recommended before publication use.

perception_uz.txt has 19 passages, not 20: TEXT 2 ('Catching a cold') passage 5 was deliberately excluded by Moldir because its audio recording was removed due to speaker disfluency (confirmed 2026-06-12). The model eval correctly scores the 19 passages that human listeners actually heard; do NOT reconstruct the missing passage.

Each file contains multiple TEXT N sections separated by headers and 1..5 section markers; these constitute under 5 percent of total chars and are kept as-is so all seven files share the same metadata pattern.

Char inventory check at receipt: 41-60 unique chars per file, zero Cyrillic leak across all six original Turkic files, Uyghur contains 51 Arabic-script punctuation chars (Arabic comma/question/semicolon) preserved from source orthography. Finnish file inventory: 38 unique chars, all in Suomi et al. 2008 broad phonemic inventory.
